domain_claim: For all data: &[u8] with data.len() > HEADER_SIZE + payload_len and otherwise valid header/CRC/digest, decode_postcard(data) returns Err(PostcardError::TrailingBytes).
notes: Primary property. P1 bug closure. Suggested property name: prop_strict_length_no_trailing_bytes. Generate arbitrary payload (length 0..=MAX_PAYLOAD) and arbitrary trailing bytes (length 1..=4096), construct (encode_postcard(v,k,p) ++ trailing), assert decode_postcard returns Err(TrailingBytes). Implementation evidence lives in verification/proptest/properties.rs. Rust-local implementation lane; no concurrency/temporal/unsafe. Verus/Flux/Miri/Loom not warranted. Kani optional with #[cfg(kani)] + kani::any() input per GOD RULE 1.

domain_claim: PostcardError::TrailingBytes is a unit variant; Display for the new variant returns a non-empty, distinguishable string; PartialEq distinguishes it from DecodeFailed.
notes: Unit test on the variant itself. Assert: std::mem::discriminant(Err(PostcardError::TrailingBytes)) != std::mem::discriminant(Err(PostcardError::DecodeFailed)); format!("{}", PostcardError::TrailingBytes) != ""; format!("{}", PostcardError::TrailingBytes) != format!("{}", PostcardError::DecodeFailed). Rust-local implementation lane.

domain_claim: For all data: &[u8] with decode_postcard(data) = Ok((_, payload)), data.len() == HEADER_SIZE + payload.len().
notes: Positive-direction invariant. For any payload p with len <= MAX_PAYLOAD, let buf = encode_postcard(v,k,p) (length = HEADER_SIZE + p.len()); assert decode_postcard(&buf).is_ok() AND buf.len() == HEADER_SIZE + payload.len() (where payload is the Ok-arm's payload slice). Extends prop_roundtrip_bijectivity. Rust-local implementation lane.

domain_claim: For all data: &[u8] with data.len() > HEADER_SIZE + payload_len_after_header and earlier stages passing, decode_postcard_json(data) returns Err(PostcardError::TrailingBytes) without remapping.
notes: End-to-end propagation. Property: for any valid postcard frame plus trailing bytes, decode_postcard_json returns the SAME variant as decode_postcard (no DecodeFailed masking). Asserts `?` chain uniformity. Rust-local implementation lane. Companion integration test in crates/vb_cli/tests/cli_integration.rs confirms the in-process encode path emits no trailing bytes (regression guard).

domain_claim: For all v: u16, k: u16, p: &[u8] with p.len() <= MAX_PAYLOAD, encode_postcard(v, k, p) returns Ok(buf) with buf.len() == HEADER_SIZE + p.len().
notes: Encoder-side invariant. Pairs with PS-TB-03 to close the roundtrip. Property name suggestion: prop_encoder_emits_exact_length. Not strictly required by the bug fix but recommended to lock down the encoder behavior so future refactors cannot reintroduce trailing bytes from the encoder. Rust-local implementation lane.

domain_claim: For all data: &[u8] of length in [HEADER_SIZE, HEADER_SIZE + MAX_PAYLOAD + N], decode_postcard(data) returns Ok iff data.len() == HEADER_SIZE + payload_len (where payload_len is read from the header) AND all header/CRC/digest checks pass.
notes: Optional fuzz/property coverage. Fuzz target suggestion: fuzz_postcard_strict_length over &[u8] of bounded length. Proptest extension: prop_strict_length_no_trailing_bytes covers the > case; combine with prop_exact_length_accepts for the == case. Not strictly required because proptest already exercises arbitrary trailing lengths; fuzz is defense-in-depth. Rust-local + hostile-input lanes.

domain_claim: Display::fmt is implemented for PostcardError::TrailingBytes and produces a non-empty string that contains a recognisable substring (e.g., "trailing") distinguishing it from sibling variants.
notes: Forensic / operator-facing assertion. Test asserts that format!("{}", PostcardError::TrailingBytes).to_lowercase().contains("trailing"). Pairs with PS-TB-02 to lock both PartialEq and Display dimensions of the new variant. Rust-local implementation lane.
